title: 掃描電子顯微鏡~Scanning electron microscopes
focus: 電子探針直徑預算、Everhart–Thornley 偵測、作用體積與放大率校正~Probe-diameter budget, Everhart–Thornley detection, interaction volume and magnification calibration
summary: 從電子波長與作用體積出發，把 Schottky 場發射源亮度、繞射、球面與色像差合成探針直徑，理解 Everhart–Thornley 偵測器與 Rose 判準如何決定停留時間，再把充電、EDS 激發體積、雜散磁場與驗收測試整合成可交付的掃描電子顯微鏡工程。~Starting from electron wavelength and interaction volume, combine Schottky field-emission brightness, diffraction, spherical and chromatic aberration into a probe diameter, see how the Everhart–Thornley detector and the Rose criterion set dwell time, then integrate charging, EDS excitation volume, stray magnetic fields and acceptance tests into deliverable scanning-electron-microscope engineering.

units.anchor: 電子束、作用體積與訊號~Electron beam, interaction volume and signals
units.title: 電子波長、作用體積與影像來源~Electron wavelength, interaction volume and image origin
units.mechanism: 掃描電子顯微鏡不成像於透鏡，而是把聚焦電子探針以光柵方式掃過樣品，逐點收集訊號強度後以同樣的掃描順序畫成影像；放大率只是掃描寬度與顯示寬度之比。電子在 1 到 30 kV 的波長為皮米等級，所以解析度不受繞射限制而受探針大小與作用體積限制。入射電子在樣品內散射成梨形的作用體積，二次電子（< 50 eV）只能從表面幾奈米逸出，帶表面形貌資訊；背向散射電子來自更深處，產率隨原子序上升，帶成分對比；特徵 X 光來自整個激發體積，用於成分分析。~A scanning electron microscope does not form an image with lenses; it rasters a focused electron probe over the specimen, collects a signal intensity point by point and paints the image in the same scan order, so magnification is merely the ratio of display width to scan width. Electron wavelengths at 1 to 30 kV are picometres, so resolution is limited not by diffraction but by probe size and interaction volume. Incident electrons scatter into a pear-shaped interaction volume: secondary electrons (< 50 eV) escape only from the top few nanometres and carry topography; backscattered electrons come from deeper and their yield rises with atomic number, carrying composition contrast; characteristic X-rays come from the whole excited volume and serve composition analysis.
units.model: 相對論電子波長 λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²))：1 kV 時 38.8 pm，5 kV 時 17.3 pm，30 kV 時 7.0 pm。Kanaya–Okayama 作用深度 R = 0.0276·A·E^1.67/(Z^0.889·ρ) µm（E 以 keV 計）：矽（A = 28.09、Z = 14、ρ = 2.33 g/cm³）在 1 kV 為 0.032 µm、5 kV 為 0.47 µm、20 kV 為 4.7 µm；金在 20 kV 只有 0.86 µm。降低加速電壓是把訊號限制在表面附近的主要手段。~Relativistic electron wavelength λ = h/√(2m₀eV(1 + eV/2m₀c²)): 38.8 pm at 1 kV, 17.3 pm at 5 kV, 7.0 pm at 30 kV. Kanaya–Okayama range R = 0.0276·A·E^1.67/(Z^0.889·ρ) µm with E in keV: silicon (A = 28.09, Z = 14, ρ = 2.33 g/cm³) gives 0.032 µm at 1 kV, 0.47 µm at 5 kV and 4.7 µm at 20 kV; gold at 20 kV only 0.86 µm. Lowering the accelerating voltage is the main way to confine the signal near the surface.
units.verify: 在矽基板上鍍 100 nm 的鋁圖案，分別以 2、5、20 kV 拍二次電子與背向散射電子影像：20 kV 時圖案邊緣因深層散射而模糊、基板資訊透出，2 kV 時邊緣銳利；以 Monte Carlo 模擬（例如 CASINO）算出的作用體積與 Kanaya–Okayama 估計及影像觀察比較。~Pattern 100 nm of aluminium on silicon and record secondary- and backscattered-electron images at 2, 5 and 20 kV: at 20 kV the edges blur through deep scattering and substrate information bleeds through, at 2 kV the edges are sharp; compare the interaction volumes from a Monte Carlo simulation such as CASINO with the Kanaya–Okayama estimate and with what the images show.
units.failure: 用 20 kV 量 50 nm 厚塗層的表面顆粒，背向散射電子來自塗層下方的基板，顆粒對比被基板訊號淹沒，誤判為塗層平整；同一樣品在 2 kV 下顆粒清楚可見。~Imaging particles on a 50 nm coating at 20 kV lets backscattered electrons from the substrate beneath swamp the particle contrast, so the coating is wrongly judged smooth; at 2 kV the same particles are clearly visible.
units.misconception: 電子波長只有皮米，所以掃描電子顯微鏡的解析度也接近皮米。~Because the electron wavelength is picometres, SEM resolution is also near a picometre.

units.anchor: 探針直徑預算表~Probe-diameter budget table
units.title: 探針直徑：亮度、繞射、球面與色像差~Probe diameter: brightness, diffraction, spherical and chromatic terms
units.mechanism: 探針是電子源經聚光鏡與物鏡縮小後的像，直徑由四項以均方根合成：源的幾何縮小像 d_g 由亮度 β、探針電流 I_p 與會聚半角 α 決定，電流越大、角度越小則越大；繞射項 d_d = 0.61λ/α 隨角度變小而變大；球面像差 d_s = 0.5·C_s·α³ 隨角度三次方增長；色像差 d_c = C_c·(ΔE/E)·α 在低加速電壓時因 ΔE/E 變大而主導。工程上以終端光圈選 α，在繞射與球面項之間取最佳值，而低電壓下的色像差只能靠低能量散佈的源、減速或單色器壓低。~The probe is the demagnified image of the source formed by condenser and objective lenses, and its diameter combines four terms in quadrature: the geometric source image d_g set by brightness β, probe current I_p and convergence semi-angle α, growing with current and shrinking angle; diffraction d_d = 0.61λ/α, growing as the angle shrinks; spherical aberration d_s = 0.5·C_s·α³, growing with the cube of angle; and chromatic aberration d_c = C_c·(ΔE/E)·α, dominant at low voltage because ΔE/E grows. The final aperture chooses α to balance diffraction against the spherical term, while low-voltage chromatic blur can only be reduced by a low-energy-spread source, beam deceleration or a monochromator.
units.model: d_p² = d_g² + d_d² + d_s² + d_c²，d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β)。教學假設 Schottky 源、I_p = 50 pA、α = 5 mrad、C_s = C_c = 2 mm、ΔE = 0.7 eV。5 kV（β = 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹、λ = 17.3 pm）：d_g = 2.0 nm、d_d = 2.1 nm、d_s = 0.13 nm、d_c = 1.4 nm，d_p ≈ 3.2 nm。1 kV（β = 4×10¹⁰）：d_g = 4.5、d_d = 4.7、d_c = 7.0 nm，d_p ≈ 9.6 nm，色像差主導；若改用 ΔE = 0.3 eV 的冷場發射源且亮度維持 2×10¹¹，1 kV 探針縮到約 6 nm。~d_p² = d_g² + d_d² + d_s² + d_c² with d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β). Teaching assumptions: Schottky source, I_p = 50 pA, α = 5 mrad, C_s = C_c = 2 mm, ΔE = 0.7 eV. At 5 kV (β = 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹, λ = 17.3 pm): d_g = 2.0 nm, d_d = 2.1 nm, d_s = 0.13 nm, d_c = 1.4 nm, d_p ≈ 3.2 nm. At 1 kV (β = 4×10¹⁰): d_g = 4.5, d_d = 4.7, d_c = 7.0 nm, d_p ≈ 9.6 nm, chromatic dominated; a cold field emitter with ΔE = 0.3 eV at the same 2×10¹¹ brightness shrinks the 1 kV probe to about 6 nm.
units.verify: 在碳膜上的金顆粒樣品量影像解析度（最小可分辨間隙或傅立葉環相關）作為探針直徑的上界，分別換 20、30、50 µm 光圈改變 α，畫出解析度對 α 的曲線，最佳點應落在 (λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10 mrad 附近；再把探針電流從 10 pA 增到 1 nA，確認解析度依 √I_p 的趨勢變差。~Measure image resolution on gold-on-carbon (smallest resolvable gap or Fourier ring correlation) as an upper bound of probe diameter, swap 20, 30 and 50 µm apertures to vary α and plot resolution against α, whose optimum should lie near (λ/C_s)^¼ ≈ 10 mrad; then raise probe current from 10 pA to 1 nA and confirm resolution degrades with the √I_p trend.
units.failure: 為了做 EDS 把探針電流調到 2 nA 後直接拍高倍影像，d_g 放大六倍以上，探針從 3 nm 變成十幾奈米，操作者以為是對焦或像散沒調好而反覆調整，實際是亮度預算用完了。~Raising probe current to 2 nA for EDS and then taking high-magnification images inflates d_g more than sixfold, the probe grows from 3 nm to over ten, and the operator keeps readjusting focus and stigmation while the real cause is an exhausted brightness budget.
units.misconception: 光圈越小探針越細，所以永遠應該用最小光圈。~A smaller aperture always gives a finer probe, so the smallest aperture should always be used.

units.anchor: Schottky 場發射槍與超高真空~Schottky field-emission gun and ultrahigh vacuum
units.title: 電子源：鎢絲、LaB₆、Schottky 與冷場發射~Electron sources: tungsten, LaB₆, Schottky and cold field emission
units.mechanism: 電子源決定亮度、能量散佈、穩定度與真空需求。鎢絲熱發射在 2800 K 工作，亮度約 10⁵ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹、能量散佈 2 到 3 eV，便宜但探針粗；LaB₆ 亮度高一個數量級。Schottky 發射器是 ZrO 覆蓋的鎢 ⟨100⟩ 尖端，在約 1800 K 與強電場下工作，亮度約 10⁸ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹、散佈 0.6 到 0.9 eV、虛擬源約 20 nm、電流穩定且壽命超過一年，需要 10⁻⁷ Pa 等級的槍室真空。冷場發射在室溫以純場發射工作，散佈 0.3 eV、亮度更高、虛擬源約 5 nm，但需要 10⁻⁸ Pa 以下的真空並定期加熱清除吸附氣體以恢復電流。~The source sets brightness, energy spread, stability and vacuum demand. A tungsten hairpin emits thermionically at 2800 K with about 10⁵ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹ and 2 to 3 eV spread, cheap but coarse; LaB₆ is an order of magnitude brighter. A Schottky emitter is a ZrO-coated tungsten ⟨100⟩ tip at about 1800 K under a strong field, giving about 10⁸ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹, 0.6 to 0.9 eV spread, a roughly 20 nm virtual source, stable current and a lifetime over a year, and it needs a gun vacuum near 10⁻⁷ Pa. A cold field emitter works at room temperature by pure field emission with 0.3 eV spread, higher brightness and a 5 nm virtual source, but needs below 10⁻⁸ Pa and periodic flashing to desorb gas and restore current.
units.model: 亮度把電流換成探針大小：d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β)。同樣 α = 5 mrad、I_p = 50 pA，β 從鎢絲的 10⁹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹ 提升到 Schottky 的 2×10¹¹ 時，d_g 由 28 nm 降到 2.0 nm（√200 ≈ 14 倍）。色像差正比於 ΔE：在 1 kV、C_c = 2 mm、α = 5 mrad 下，ΔE = 2.5 eV 的鎢絲給 d_c = 25 nm，Schottky 0.7 eV 給 7 nm，冷場 0.3 eV 給 3 nm。~Brightness converts current into probe size through d_g = (2/πα)·√(I_p/β). At the same α = 5 mrad and I_p = 50 pA, raising β from a tungsten hairpin's 10⁹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹ to a Schottky emitter's 2×10¹¹ shrinks d_g from 28 nm to 2.0 nm (√200 ≈ 14 times). Chromatic blur scales with ΔE: at 1 kV with C_c = 2 mm and α = 5 mrad, a 2.5 eV tungsten spread gives d_c = 25 nm, Schottky 0.7 eV gives 7 nm and cold field emission 0.3 eV gives 3 nm.
units.verify: 以法拉第杯量探針電流並記錄 8 小時的漂移，Schottky 源應在 1% 內、冷場源在閃熱後呈指數衰減；用槍室的離子泵電流讀真空並確認在 10⁻⁷ Pa 以下；能量散佈以能量分析器或由低電壓解析度隨 ΔE 的變化間接驗證；記錄抽取電壓與加熱電流的操作點，與原廠交付值比較以判斷尖端老化。~Measure probe current in a Faraday cup and log 8 hours of drift, expecting a Schottky source within 1% and a cold emitter to decay exponentially after flashing; read gun vacuum from the ion-pump current and confirm it is below 10⁻⁷ Pa; verify energy spread with an energy analyser or indirectly through low-voltage resolution versus ΔE; record extractor voltage and heating current and compare with factory values to judge tip ageing.
units.failure: 槍室真空因閥門微漏升到 10⁻⁵ Pa，Schottky 尖端的 ZrO 被氧化、發射面長出棱面，電流在數小時內跳動數十個百分比，影像出現水平亮暗條紋，最後只能更換整個發射器。~A small valve leak raising gun vacuum to 10⁻⁵ Pa oxidises the ZrO on the Schottky tip and facets grow on the emitting surface; current jumps by tens of percent within hours, images show horizontal bright and dark bands, and the whole emitter must eventually be replaced.
units.misconception: 場發射源的亮度高，所以任何電流下探針都比鎢絲細。~A field-emission source is brighter, so its probe is finer at every current than a tungsten hairpin's.

units.anchor: 物鏡、光圈與 Everhart–Thornley 偵測器~Objective lens, aperture and Everhart–Thornley detector
units.title: 電子光學柱與二次電子偵測~Electron-optical column and secondary-electron detection
units.mechanism: 電子光學柱由槍、兩到三級聚光鏡、終端光圈、掃描線圈、像散校正器與物鏡組成；物鏡的 C_s 與 C_c 隨工作距離增加而變大，所以高解析度要短工作距離或把樣品浸在磁場中的浸沒式物鏡。Everhart–Thornley 偵測器是一個帶 +300 V 柵網的法拉第籠，把低能量的二次電子吸引過來，再由 +10 kV 的閃爍體加速成光，經光導與光電倍增管轉成電訊號；柵網加負壓時只收背向散射電子。鏡筒內偵測器則收集被物鏡磁場捲回柱內的二次電子，在短工作距離下效率最高。~The column comprises the gun, two or three condenser lenses, a final aperture, scan coils, stigmators and the objective lens; the objective's C_s and C_c grow with working distance, so high resolution needs a short working distance or an immersion lens that bathes the specimen in its field. The Everhart–Thornley detector is a Faraday cage with a +300 V grid that draws in low-energy secondary electrons, a +10 kV scintillator that accelerates them into light, and a light guide to a photomultiplier; biasing the grid negative collects only backscattered electrons. In-lens detectors collect secondaries spiralled back up the column by the objective field and are most efficient at short working distance.
units.model: Rose 判準：要辨識對比 C 需每像素偵測到 n ≥ (5/C)² 個電子。C = 10% → n = 2500。探針 50 pA = 3.1×10⁸ e/s，二次電子產率 δ = 0.3、收集效率 0.5 → 4.7×10⁷ 偵測電子/s，所需停留時間 2500/4.7×10⁷ ≈ 53 µs，1024×1024 影像需 56 s；對比只有 3% 時 n = 27,800、單幀超過 10 分鐘，必須提高電流或接受更粗的探針。~Rose criterion: to see contrast C each pixel needs n ≥ (5/C)² detected electrons. C = 10% → n = 2500. A 50 pA probe is 3.1×10⁸ e/s; with secondary yield δ = 0.3 and collection efficiency 0.5 that is 4.7×10⁷ detected electrons/s, a dwell of 2500/4.7×10⁷ ≈ 53 µs and 56 s for a 1024×1024 frame; at only 3% contrast n = 27,800 and a frame exceeds 10 minutes, forcing higher current or a coarser probe.
units.verify: 以法拉第杯校正探針電流後，在平坦碳膜上量偵測器輸出的均值與標準差隨停留時間的關係，訊噪比應隨 √(停留時間) 增長；切換柵網 +300 V 與 −50 V 比較形貌對比與成分對比；在不同工作距離量解析度，確認 C_s、C_c 隨工作距離變大的趨勢。~After calibrating probe current with a Faraday cup, measure the detector's mean and standard deviation on a flat carbon film against dwell time, expecting signal-to-noise to grow as √(dwell); switch the grid between +300 V and −50 V to compare topographic and compositional contrast; measure resolution at several working distances and confirm that C_s and C_c grow with working distance.
units.failure: 光電倍增管高壓調得過高並把亮度拉滿，影像看似訊號很強，其實每像素只有幾十個電子，雜訊被放大成假紋理；真正的改善是增加停留時間或電流，而不是增益。~Pushing photomultiplier voltage and brightness to the limit makes the image look strong while each pixel holds only tens of electrons, so noise is amplified into false texture; the real fix is more dwell time or current, not gain.
units.misconception: Everhart–Thornley 偵測器只收集二次電子，不受背向散射電子影響。~The Everhart–Thornley detector collects only secondary electrons and is unaffected by backscattered electrons.

units.anchor: 節距標準片與像素尺度~Pitch standard and pixel scale
units.title: 放大率校正、像素取樣與解析度量測~Magnification calibration, pixel sampling and resolution measurement
units.mechanism: 影像上的長度由掃描線圈的電流對樣品面位移的比例決定，這個比例隨加速電壓、工作距離與線圈溫度變化，所以每個條件都要用節距已知且可溯源的光柵標準片校正；像素尺寸 = 掃描寬度/像素數，必須小於探針直徑的一半才算有效取樣，再放大只是「空放大」。解析度不應只看規格表，要用金顆粒碳膜樣品量最小可分辨間隙，或用兩張獨立影像的傅立葉環相關求出資訊極限。~Length in the image comes from the ratio of scan-coil current to displacement on the specimen, and this ratio changes with accelerating voltage, working distance and coil temperature, so every condition is calibrated with a traceable grating of known pitch; pixel size = scan width/pixel count must be below half the probe diameter for useful sampling, and further magnification is empty. Resolution should not be read from a data sheet but measured as the smallest resolvable gap on gold-on-carbon or as the information limit from Fourier ring correlation of two independent images.
units.model: 3.2 nm 探針需要 ≤ 1.5 nm 像素：1024 像素對應掃描寬度 1.54 µm，在 300 mm 顯示器上相當於約 195,000 倍；再往上放大只是放大像素。放大率校正：量 100 nm 節距光柵的 20 個週期得到 2.00 µm 與證書值比較，若讀值 2.04 µm 則比例誤差 2%，校正後殘餘由光柵證書（0.3%）與邊緣定位（0.2 像素）決定，約 0.5%。~A 3.2 nm probe needs pixels ≤ 1.5 nm: 1024 pixels then span 1.54 µm, about 195,000× on a 300 mm display, and more magnification only enlarges pixels. Calibration: measure 20 periods of a 100 nm grating, 2.00 µm, against the certificate; a reading of 2.04 µm is a 2% scale error, and after correction the residual is set by the grating certificate (0.3%) and edge location (0.2 pixel), about 0.5%.
units.verify: 在常用的每組（電壓、工作距離、放大率）條件下量光柵標準片的 x 與 y 節距，紀錄比例因子與正交性誤差並建立校正表；用解析度樣品在 1、5、15 kV 各測一次最小間隙並存檔影像；每月重複，比例因子漂移超過 1% 即重新校正並追溯期間的量測結果。~For each routinely used (voltage, working distance, magnification) set measure the grating pitch in x and y, log scale factor and orthogonality error into a calibration table; measure the smallest gap on the resolution specimen at 1, 5 and 15 kV and archive the images; repeat monthly, and when the scale factor drifts beyond 1% recalibrate and review measurements from the interval.
units.failure: 在 10 kV、10 mm 工作距離校正的放大率被沿用到 2 kV、4 mm 的條件，比例因子差 3%，線寬量測全部偏大，直到客戶用 AFM 複量才被發現。~A magnification calibrated at 10 kV and 10 mm working distance is reused at 2 kV and 4 mm, the scale factor differs by 3%, every line-width measurement reads large, and the problem surfaces only when a customer re-measures by AFM.
units.misconception: 顯示的放大率數字就是校正過的尺度，與工作條件無關。~The displayed magnification number is a calibrated scale independent of operating conditions.

units.anchor: 充電平衡點與 EDS 激發體積~Charging crossover and EDS excitation volume
units.title: 充電、鍍膜、低真空與 EDS 激發體積~Charging, coating, low vacuum and EDS excitation volume
units.mechanism: 絕緣樣品的總產率 σ = δ + η 隨能量變化，在第二交叉點 E₂（多數氧化物與高分子約 1 到 3 kV）等於 1；高於 E₂ 時電子淨流入、表面帶負電，影像變亮、漂移、甚至把入射束偏轉；低於 E₂ 時輕微帶正電而自限。對策是把電壓選在 E₂ 附近、鍍數奈米的導電膜、或用數十帕的低真空讓氣體離子中和表面。能量散佈 X 光譜（EDS）需要過電壓比 E₀/E_c ≥ 2 才有足夠激發，X 光來自整個激發體積，所以成分的空間解析度通常是微米等級，與影像的奈米解析度完全不同。~An insulator's total yield σ = δ + η varies with energy and equals 1 at the second crossover E₂, about 1 to 3 kV for most oxides and polymers; above E₂ electrons accumulate, the surface charges negative, the image brightens, drifts and can even deflect the incoming beam, while below E₂ mild positive charging is self-limiting. Remedies are choosing the voltage near E₂, coating a few nanometres of conductor, or low vacuum at tens of pascals so gas ions neutralise the surface. Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) needs an overvoltage ratio E₀/E_c ≥ 2 for efficient excitation, and X-rays come from the whole excited volume, so compositional spatial resolution is usually micrometres, unlike the nanometre resolution of the image.
units.model: Castaing X 光產生深度 R_x ≈ 0.033·(E₀^1.7 − E_c^1.7)·A/(ρZ) µm：銅 Kα（E_c = 8.04 keV）在 20 kV 為 1.0 µm；矽 Kα（1.74 keV）在 20 kV 為 4.6 µm、在 5 kV 為 0.37 µm。因此 20 nm 的顆粒不可能用 20 kV 的 EDS 單獨定量，它的訊號被周圍微米級體積稀釋超過 100 倍；降到 5 kV 用 L 線分析可把體積縮小一個數量級。~Castaing X-ray generation range R_x ≈ 0.033·(E₀^1.7 − E_c^1.7)·A/(ρZ) µm: copper Kα (E_c = 8.04 keV) at 20 kV gives 1.0 µm; silicon Kα (1.74 keV) gives 4.6 µm at 20 kV and 0.37 µm at 5 kV. A 20 nm particle therefore cannot be quantified alone by 20 kV EDS, its signal diluted more than 100-fold by the surrounding micrometre-scale volume; dropping to 5 kV with L lines shrinks the volume by an order of magnitude.
units.verify: 在未鍍膜的氧化鋁或 PMMA 上從 0.5 kV 逐步升壓拍同一區域，找出影像由穩定轉為漂移發亮的電壓即 E₂；比較鍍 5 nm 鉑與低真空 50 Pa 兩種對策的影像穩定性與解析度損失；EDS 用純銅標準片在 20 kV 校正能量尺度（Kα 8.04 keV）與解析度（Mn Kα 處約 125 eV），並以多層標準片驗證激發深度估計。~On uncoated alumina or PMMA raise the voltage from 0.5 kV in steps while imaging the same area and find E₂ where the image turns from stable to drifting and bright; compare image stability and resolution loss for a 5 nm platinum coat versus 50 Pa low vacuum; calibrate EDS energy scale on pure copper at 20 kV (Kα 8.04 keV) and resolution (about 125 eV at Mn Kα), and verify the excitation-depth estimate on a multilayer standard.
units.failure: 為了做 EDS 把高分子樣品調到 20 kV 而未鍍膜，表面累積負電把入射束偏開，影像拉伸、掃描框扭曲，EDS 圖譜中的位置對不上影像位置，整批定量結果作廢。~Running an uncoated polymer at 20 kV for EDS lets accumulated negative charge deflect the beam, the image stretches and the scan frame warps, EDS map positions no longer match the image and the whole batch of quantification is discarded.
units.misconception: EDS 成分圖的空間解析度和二次電子影像一樣是奈米級。~EDS composition maps have the same nanometre spatial resolution as the secondary-electron image.

units.anchor: 雜散磁場、振動與聲學環境~Stray fields, vibration and acoustic environment
units.title: 場址整合：雜散磁場、振動與聲學~Site integration: stray magnetic fields, vibration and acoustics
units.mechanism: 電子束是帶電粒子，在物鏡與樣品之間的最後一段幾乎沒有屏蔽，環境的交流磁場會把探針以電源頻率左右搖擺，影像邊緣出現鋸齒；低電壓時電子動量小、偏轉更大。地板振動經由樣品台放大，使影像在掃描中錯位；聲音則直接搖動鏡筒。因此安裝前必須做場址調查，量 1 到 1000 Hz 的磁場、振動與聲壓，必要時加主動磁場消除器、主動隔振平台與隔音罩，並把顯微鏡遠離電梯、變壓器與空調。~The electron beam is a charged particle and its final path between objective and specimen is almost unshielded, so ambient ac magnetic fields rock the probe at mains frequency and image edges turn jagged; at low voltage the electron momentum is smaller and the deflection larger. Floor vibration, amplified through the stage, displaces the image during the scan, and sound shakes the column directly. A site survey measuring 1 to 1000 Hz magnetic field, vibration and sound pressure therefore precedes installation, with active field cancellation, active isolation and acoustic enclosures added when needed, and the microscope kept away from lifts, transformers and air handlers.
units.model: 磁場偏轉：半徑 r = p/(eB)，在長度 L 內的橫移 ≈ L²/(2r)。1 kV 電子（p = 1.71×10⁻²³ kg·m/s）在 B = 30 nT（0.3 mG）、L = 10 mm 的未屏蔽路徑上橫移 ≈ 14 nm；B = 300 nT 時 140 nm；15 kV 時同樣 30 nT 只有 3.6 nm。鏡筒末端若有 20 倍的屏蔽係數，1 kV 的 14 nm 降到 0.7 nm，這就是常見 0.3 mG 場址規格的來源。~Field deflection: radius r = p/(eB), lateral shift over length L ≈ L²/(2r). A 1 kV electron (p = 1.71×10⁻²³ kg·m/s) in B = 30 nT (0.3 mG) over an unshielded L = 10 mm shifts ≈ 14 nm; at 300 nT, 140 nm; at 15 kV the same 30 nT gives only 3.6 nm. With a shielding factor of 20 at the column end the 1 kV figure drops to 0.7 nm, which is where the common 0.3 mG site specification comes from.
units.verify: 以三軸磁通閘計量安裝點的 50/60 Hz 與直流磁場，以加速規量地板在 1 到 100 Hz 的速度譜，與原廠場址規格比較；安裝後在 1 kV 拍高倍影像並做傅立葉分析，影像中出現的電源頻率週期性鋸齒幅度可直接換算回殘餘磁場；開啟主動消磁後重測。~Measure 50/60 Hz and dc fields at the site with a three-axis fluxgate and floor velocity spectra from 1 to 100 Hz with an accelerometer, comparing with the vendor's site specification; after installation take a 1 kV high-magnification image and Fourier-analyse it, converting the amplitude of mains-frequency jaggedness back into residual field; re-measure with active cancellation on.
units.failure: 顯微鏡裝在配電室隔壁，60 Hz 磁場 2 mG 使 1 kV 影像邊緣出現 100 nm 的鋸齒，被誤認為樣品本身的粗糙；在 15 kV 下看似正常，於是低電壓表面影像能力整個被放棄。~A microscope next to a switch room sees a 2 mG 60 Hz field, 1 kV image edges show 100 nm jaggedness mistaken for specimen roughness, and because 15 kV images look fine the low-voltage surface-imaging capability is simply abandoned.
units.misconception: 鏡筒是金屬做的，所以外部磁場進不去。~The column is metal, so external magnetic fields cannot get in.

units.anchor: 驗收測試與操作規範~Acceptance tests and operating procedures
units.title: 驗收、漂移與工程交接~Acceptance, drift and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 驗收不是看一張漂亮影像，而是在約定條件下重現可量化的指標：在指定電壓與工作距離量解析度樣品、以節距光柵量放大率、以法拉第杯量探針電流、以 EDS 標準片量能量解析度，並量影像漂移與樣品台重現性。漂移來自樣品台熱平衡、鏡筒熱膨脹與充電，在長停留時間的高解析度影像中會把探針的優勢抹掉。交接文件包含各條件的校正表、場址量測、每月維護項目（光圈清潔、尖端閃熱、法拉第杯校正）、以及針對絕緣與高分子樣品的操作規範。~Acceptance is not one handsome image but reproducible, quantified indicators under agreed conditions: resolution on the standard specimen at specified voltage and working distance, magnification on a pitch grating, probe current in a Faraday cup, EDS energy resolution on a standard, plus image drift and stage repeatability. Drift arises from stage thermal settling, column expansion and charging, and in long-dwell high-resolution frames it erases the probe's advantage. The handoff package holds calibration tables per condition, site measurements, monthly maintenance items (aperture cleaning, tip flashing, Faraday-cup calibration) and operating procedures for insulating and polymer specimens.
units.model: 漂移預算：1 nm/min 的漂移在 56 s 的單幀內造成 0.93 nm 的拖影，對 3.2 nm 探針是 29% 的損失；要把拖影壓到探針的 10%（0.32 nm），漂移必須小於 0.34 nm/min，或改用 8 幀各 7 s 的快速掃描並以互相關對齊後疊加。驗收指標範例：1 kV 解析度 ≤ 10 nm、5 kV ≤ 3.5 nm、放大率誤差 ≤ 1%、探針電流 8 h 穩定度 ≤ 2%、EDS Mn Kα 解析度 ≤ 130 eV。~Drift budget: 1 nm/min over a 56 s frame smears 0.93 nm, a 29% loss on a 3.2 nm probe; to hold the smear to 10% of the probe (0.32 nm) drift must stay below 0.34 nm/min, or use 8 fast frames of 7 s each aligned by cross-correlation and summed. Example acceptance indicators: 1 kV resolution ≤ 10 nm, 5 kV ≤ 3.5 nm, magnification error ≤ 1%, probe-current stability ≤ 2% over 8 h, EDS Mn Kα resolution ≤ 130 eV.
units.verify: 樣品裝入後每 2 分鐘拍一次同區域影像共 30 分鐘，以互相關算出位移曲線並找出達到 0.3 nm/min 所需的穩定時間；依驗收表逐項測試並由雙方簽署；把每項數值、影像與條件存入交接檔案，作為日後效能退化的基準。~After loading, image the same area every 2 minutes for 30 minutes, derive the displacement curve by cross-correlation and find the settling time needed to reach 0.3 nm/min; test every item in the acceptance table and have both parties sign; store every value, image and condition in the handoff file as the baseline for future degradation.
units.failure: 驗收只在 15 kV、短工作距離下拍一張金顆粒影像便簽收，交機後使用者主要在 1 kV 看高分子，解析度與漂移從未在那個條件驗證，半年後才發現低電壓效能不足但已無合約依據。~Acceptance signed on one gold-particle image at 15 kV and short working distance, while the user mainly works at 1 kV on polymers; resolution and drift were never verified under that condition, and when the low-voltage performance proves inadequate six months later there is no contractual basis left.
units.misconception: 驗收時影像夠清楚就代表所有條件下都達到規格。~A clear image at acceptance proves specification is met under all conditions.

example: 成像條件設計練習：在碳膜上拍 20 nm 金顆粒，Schottky 源、5 kV、I_p = 50 pA、α = 5 mrad、C_s = C_c = 2 mm、ΔE = 0.7 eV、β = 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹。λ = 17.3 pm；d_g = (2/(π×0.005))×√(5×10⁻¹¹/2×10¹¹) = 2.0 nm；d_d = 0.61×17.3 pm/0.005 = 2.1 nm；d_s = 0.5×2 mm×(0.005)³ = 0.13 nm；d_c = 2 mm×(0.7/5000)×0.005 = 1.4 nm；d_p = √(2.0² + 2.1² + 0.13² + 1.4²) ≈ 3.2 nm，對 20 nm 顆粒足夠。像素取 1.5 nm → 1024 像素掃描寬 1.54 µm。對比 C = 10%、δ = 0.3、收集效率 0.5：每像素需 2500 個偵測電子，停留 53 µs，單幀 56 s。若漂移 1 nm/min，拖影 0.93 nm；改成 8 幀各 7 s 對齊疊加，單幀拖影 0.12 nm。要用 EDS 確認顆粒是金，20 kV 的 Au Mα 激發體積約 1 µm，顆粒訊號被稀釋百倍以上，所以改用 5 kV 的 Au Mα（2.12 keV，過電壓比 2.4）並接受更長的計數時間。數值為教學假設，不代表任何儀器規格。~Imaging-condition exercise: image 20 nm gold particles on carbon with a Schottky source at 5 kV, I_p = 50 pA, α = 5 mrad, C_s = C_c = 2 mm, ΔE = 0.7 eV, β = 2×10¹¹ A m⁻² sr⁻¹. λ = 17.3 pm; d_g = (2/(π×0.005))×√(5×10⁻¹¹/2×10¹¹) = 2.0 nm; d_d = 0.61×17.3 pm/0.005 = 2.1 nm; d_s = 0.5×2 mm×(0.005)³ = 0.13 nm; d_c = 2 mm×(0.7/5000)×0.005 = 1.4 nm; d_p = √(2.0² + 2.1² + 0.13² + 1.4²) ≈ 3.2 nm, adequate for 20 nm particles. Choose 1.5 nm pixels → 1024 pixels span 1.54 µm. With contrast C = 10%, δ = 0.3 and collection efficiency 0.5, each pixel needs 2500 detected electrons, a 53 µs dwell and a 56 s frame. With 1 nm/min drift the smear is 0.93 nm; switching to 8 aligned frames of 7 s each cuts the per-frame smear to 0.12 nm. To confirm the particles are gold by EDS, the Au Mα excitation volume at 20 kV is about 1 µm and the particle signal is diluted more than a hundredfold, so use Au Mα at 5 kV (2.12 keV, overvoltage ratio 2.4) and accept longer counting. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1930 年代 Knoll 與 von Ardenne 提出並實作掃描式電子成像，1940 年代 Zworykin 團隊在 RCA 建造早期原型；1950 到 60 年代劍橋大學 Oatley 實驗室解決了偵測與訊噪問題，Everhart 與 Thornley 在 1960 年發表的閃爍體加光電倍增管偵測器至今仍是標準配備，1965 年 Cambridge Instruments 推出第一台商用 SEM。1980 年代起場發射源與浸沒式物鏡把解析度推到奈米以下，低電壓成像與能譜分析使 SEM 成為半導體與材料產業的基礎工具。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。~Knoll and von Ardenne proposed and demonstrated scanned electron imaging in the 1930s and Zworykin's group at RCA built early prototypes in the 1940s; in the 1950s and 60s Oatley's laboratory at Cambridge solved detection and signal-to-noise problems, the scintillator-photomultiplier detector published by Everhart and Thornley in 1960 remains standard equipment, and Cambridge Instruments shipped the first commercial SEM in 1965. From the 1980s field-emission sources and immersion objectives pushed resolution below a nanometre, and low-voltage imaging with spectroscopy made the SEM a foundation tool of the semiconductor and materials industries. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering methods only.
